Earlier: measured 11/10/2026 (tasks/evidence/ds-contracts-batch3-2026-10-11/templates/ja-good-j6): default unchanged, no text made less readable than the template's own under the systems tried, 92% or more of the page follows; measured on /index.php/home-layouts/home-news (measuredPage): the quickstart's home page is a demo chooser with no running text; on phone the page scrolls sideways in the template's own default too (not the slot's)
contrastNote: block: text set straight in a div that holds only inline content (a hero title, an eyebrow) — outside the heading and text kinds, added at the re-measure of 11/10/2026; heading and text: every visible heading and text element, judged element by element against the same element in the template’s own look (flow.mjs samples) — added at the re-measure of 11/10/2026, the contract was ready on the four first-match probes only
followNote: the category labels on the slideshow and the big news cards of the news-3 and news-4 layouts are painted with the accent, the label holding the accent's text (tokenized), but the link inside it keeps a fixed white: white on a light accent read 1.9–2.6:1 under Moxie, MotherDuck and Toggl Track — the link takes the accent's own text (accent-on). The brick layout's label keeps its fixed blue and white (not tokenized), so it is left out; 14/10/2026 (visual review, round 3): the header’s light/dark toggle (.ja-theme-toggle, its moon and sun drawn in currentColor) is set in the template’s literal #1a1a1a — its heading ink (fg-2) — so it stayed near black on the dark page of a dark system (Moxie: #1a1a1a on #000). It takes the system’s heading ink (fg-2), as the template’s own value is that role
sideRulesNote: the photo cards of the news-3 layout set their byline and date (.article-info dd, the template's grey #999999) on the photo's lower part, already hard to read in the template's own look (1.4–1.5:1 on that photo); worn, they took the system's meta text and read 1.0–1.4:1 — on both sides of light they keep the template's own grey, so no system makes them worse
keepColorsNote: the kept dark bands (.t3-header on #0a0a0a; .brick-layout and its .brick-article-footer on #000000) carry their own text colour #555555 that their pieces inherit; without it they took the system text (dark under a light system, on the bands' near-black) — the kept-band check counted 25–29 changed values in every worn view
bandsNote: drafted 2026-10-12 by scripts/bands.mjs off the released default page (/index.php/home-layouts/home-news): each kept band that is not a picture wears the system's ground (src/bands.mjs), its words keep their colours; the header (.t3-header) is no longer a band: it was drafted off the news home, whose template style paints it a black bar (#0a0a0a) with a white wordmark and a banner, the main menu below it; on every other page the template paints it white and the main menu sits inside it in a white box. As a band it wore the system’s ink on every page: on the inner pages a dark bar around the menu’s white box, the dark wordmark lost on it (visual review 14/10/2026). Now the header that holds the main menu takes the page colour (followRules) and its wordmark flips on a dark system (sideRules.dark: a contract filter there takes the place of the general logo rule); the news home’s black bar keeps the template’s neutral black under its white wordmark
literalsNote: #999999: the bylines of the big news card sit on its photo, in the template’s own grey whatever the system
reviewV8Note: 15/10/2026 (look review v8): the phone menu’s bars are #1a1a1a in off-canvas.css (untokenized): on a dark system’s black header they vanished; they take the strong text like the menu’s other icons
